sequential_semantics: On each rising clk edge, Q captures r_in when L is 1, otherwise q_in. Between rising edges Q holds.
numeric_widths: All signals one-bit unsigned; no arithmetic
latency_reset_behavior: Output updates after rising-edge nonblocking assignment; no reset or specified initialization; one register stage, every cycle accepted.
verification_plan: Exhaust all eight L/q_in/r_in combinations repeatedly
Verify no output response to input changes or falling clock edges
